_comment: Aelgard boss design bible. Mirror of data/npc-bibles.json for boss encounters — mechanic summary, attack rotation, enrage phase, loot uniqueness. Supplements reports/boss-principle-audit.md (which rates code compliance) with DESIGN narration. The live NPC stat data lives in src/content/aelgard/bosses-expanded.js, raids-bosses-mega.js, raids-mega1/2.js, and bosses-principle-fixes.js. This file is the bible that the codex/narrator/raid-interface reads at runtime.
_audit_reference: reports/boss-principle-audit.md (87 bosses audited against 18 Scape-Builder-Injects principles; 1066/1566 cells violating; 15 top-priority patches applied)
_invocation_compatible: all entries include stat_shape and phase_markers so the raid-invocations subsystem can modulate them at runtime (HP multiplier, attack-speed, phase-thresholds)

_design_principles_shorthand.P14: asymmetric escalation (buff player, buff boss more)

bosses.name: Bryophyta
bosses.mechanic_summary: Moss giant queen; spawns growthling-rooted puddles under players every 6 ticks; puddles tether player to spot if stood on. Queen pulls player toward puddles via vine-grab on odd ticks.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: basic melee swing (max 14)
Tick 3: vine-grab on highest-HP player (pull 3 tiles toward boss)
Tick 6: growthling puddle spawn at furthest player's last known position
Tick 9: AoE moss-cloud (3-tile radius, damage reduces prayer points by 10)

enrage_phase.changes: attack_speed 4 -> 3; puddle spawn frequency doubles; vine-grab chains to 2 players

uniques.note: already an OSRS-analogue — stays the key mechanic

bosses.counterplay: magic weakness; run through puddles instead of around; face-tank vine-grabs with high def gear.

bosses.name: Obor
bosses.mechanic_summary: Hill giant capstone boss; throws 3-tile radius boulders every 7 ticks; boulders persist for 4 ticks as impassable terrain. Arena has 4 destructible pillars the boss can use for cover.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: heavy melee swing (max 16)
Tick 4: boulder throw (3-tile AoE, 4-tick persistence)
Tick 7: pillar crash (if adjacent to pillar, pillar collapses and stuns nearby players)

enrage_phase.changes: boulder frequency increases; boulders now stun on hit (1 tick)

uniques.note: sidegrade to granite maul — faster but lower max
reagent: 3 fragments + base club at Smith Kael = Boulder-clad Club (crush-niche vs construct-tag)

bosses.counterplay: stab weakness; do NOT stand behind pillars he can crash; boulder tiles block melee path, kite around them.

bosses.name: Sarachnis
bosses.mechanic_summary: Matriarch spider; spawns 2-3 spiderlings every 10 ticks that pursue player. Web-shoot attack tethers player for 2 ticks unless broken. Spiderlings heal boss if allowed to reach her.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: melee lunge (max 24)
Tick 4: web-shoot at furthest player (tether 2 ticks)
Tick 7: spiderling spawn (2-3 per wave)
Tick 10: AoE web-splash (prayer-drain 15 points)

enrage_phase.changes: spiderlings spawn 4 per wave; web-shoot hits all players on aggro list simultaneously

uniques.note: P12 — mid-tier slash weapon with passive spiderling-kill damage doubling

bosses.counterplay: slash weakness; PRIORITY — kill spiderlings before they reach boss (heal-loop mistake compounding, P05); web-tether can be broken with ranged hit or magic spell.

bosses.name: Skotizo
bosses.mechanic_summary: Catacombs altar-boss; uses 4 altars as power source (N/E/S/W). Unbroken altars grant Skotizo 75% damage reduction and 2x max hit. Players must dismantle altars during combat to become vulnerable.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: melee strike (max 14 base, 28 with altars)
Tick 4: dark shield absorb — next 2 hits on Skotizo dealt to random altar instead
Tick 7: altar-link lightning (if 2+ altars intact, lightning chains between altars through player position)

enrage_phase.changes: Skotizo fully vulnerable; attack_speed 5 -> 3; summons 2 demon-spawns

uniques.note: P11 — alt loadout: pairs with dark-claws-off weapon for paired-claw special attack

bosses.counterplay: multi-style resistance; designed for AoE damage to break altars while dodging altar-link lightning. Single-style parties struggle.

bosses.name: Duke Sucellus
bosses.mechanic_summary: Forge-Duke boss; seated on a throne that can be tipped via cardinal shockwaves. Arena has 4 gas vents. Gas vent eruptions force players to specific tiles while shockwave deals heavy damage.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: sword-thrust (max 22, melee range)
Tick 3: shockwave in a cardinal direction (tell: boss faces one direction for 2 ticks prior)
Tick 6: gas vent eruption (random 2 vents ignite, 3-tile radius, 31 damage)
Tick 10: throne-pound (stun radius 4 tiles from boss)

enrage_phase.changes: all 4 gas vents erupt simultaneously; shockwaves become diagonal instead of cardinal (harder to read direction)

uniques.note: reagent: + virtus body + nihil dust = Virtus magus robes (endgame magic)

bosses.counterplay: ranged weakness; shockwave direction telegraphed via boss-facing (P18 visual honesty); use tipped-throne phases to step in for burst.

bosses.name: Tempoross
bosses.mechanic_summary: Skilling-boss, not combat: Tempoross cannot be damaged by weapons. Players fish / cook / operate cannons cooperatively while it drains the boat's hit points. Failure sinks the boat; success awards fishing XP + unique tackle box drops.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: storm-gust AoE damage to boat (players must repair with planks)
Tick 5: vortex spawn (player must dodge; vortex pulls into sea)
Tick 8: wave-barrage (damages cannons, forces reload cycle)

enrage_phase.changes: storm-gust frequency doubles; vortex count 1 -> 3; cannons take double damage

uniques.note: unique: infinite water-rune source for autocasting

bosses.counterplay: community boss — team scaling; high fishing + firemaking levels are rewarded; the fight is a SKILL check, not a DPS check. P16-compliant (team unite).

bosses.name: The Leviathan
bosses.mechanic_summary: Sea-dragon; submerges mid-fight and sweeps the arena from one half at a time with its tail-breath. Players must reposition to unmarked half. Drains prayer on each sweep.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: melee bite (max 25 if in melee range)
Tick 4: ranged spear-throw (max 28)
Tick 8: submerge — mark half of arena, 2-tick warning, then sweep (max 33, prayer drain -25)

enrage_phase.changes: submerge sweep covers 3/4 of arena; only narrow corridor is safe

uniques.note: reagent: + fishing rod = trawler-tier rod (Saltbrine endgame fishing)

bosses.counterplay: ranged weakness; sweep-direction telegraphed (P18); burst DPS during submerge startup.

bosses.name: Phantom Muspah
bosses.mechanic_summary: Shapeshifts between ranged (bow-phantom) and melee (sword-phantom) forms every 5 ticks. Prayer must match current form. Misread prayer = double damage.
attack_rotation: Tick 1 (ranged phase): bow volley (max 32, ranged defense matters)
Tick 5: shapeshift — visible aura-color change (blue -> red)
Tick 6 (melee phase): rapid claw-strike (max 28, melee defense)
Tick 10: shapeshift back

enrage_phase.changes: shapeshift every 3 ticks instead of 5; adds magic form (yellow aura) as third rotation

uniques.note: reagent: 5 shards + magic shortbow = venator bow (prayer-defense-ignoring ranged — niche)

bosses.counterplay: aura-color is the prayer cue (P18 visual honesty); high multi-style defense loadouts trivialize the fight — but cost effective supplies.

bosses.name: The Whisperer
bosses.mechanic_summary: Dual-plane boss: half of the fight in the waking world, half in the dream-world. Players must enter dream-portal mid-combat to deal real damage; outside the portal, only 20% damage lands.
attack_rotation: Tick 1 (waking): magic dart (max 20, ranged defense)
Tick 4 (waking): dream-portal opens (3-tile rune-circle telegraph)
Player enters dream (tick 5-12): inside dream, Whisperer attacks with tendril (max 34, magic defense), 100% damage dealt by player
Tick 13: player forced back to waking

enrage_phase.changes: dream-portal stays open for only 4 ticks (shorter window); tendril attack frequency doubles inside dream

uniques.note: reagent: + virtus robes + nihil dust = virtus robes (endgame magic set)

bosses.counterplay: stab weakness; portal-cycle timing matters more than raw DPS. Classic plane-shift mechanic, P01 multiple optimal actions (enter portal or stack-heal outside).

bosses.name: Crystal Wyrm
bosses.mechanic_summary: Three-phase Veilwood dragon with crystallite pillars and arena-glass hazards. Most principle-compliant boss in the audit — pillars are interactive entities, phases teach-then-combine.
attack_rotation: Phase 1 (100-66% HP): magic breath, crystallite minion spawns (2 per wave, focus-fire kills)
Phase 2 (66-33% HP): arena shatters into mirror-glass; refract attacks from any angle; must hide behind intact pillars
Phase 3 (33-0% HP): enrage + blitz; wyrm flies between pillars; only ranged attacks land

enrage_phase.changes: flight mode — only ranged/magic hit; pillar-shelter timer halved

uniques.note: reagent: + refracted_essence = Crystal Bane (slayer-niche vs crystal-tag)

bosses.counterplay: stab weakness; phase-2 is the teach moment for pillar-shelter mechanic; phase-3 rewards ranged loadout.

bosses.name: Nex
bosses.mechanic_summary: Endgame 5-phase GWD-tier boss: Smoke / Shadow / Blood / Ice / Zaros phase sequence. Each phase requires a different prayer and protection scheme. Minion-kill required to progress between phases.
attack_rotation: Phase 1 (Smoke): AoE smoke volley, protect from missiles; minion: Fumus (summons smoke pools)
Phase 2 (Shadow): shadow clones of party, protect from magic; minion: Umbra
Phase 3 (Blood): vampiric heal on unprotected hits, protect from melee; minion: Cruor
Phase 4 (Ice): freeze + shatter (moving = max 38); minion: Glacies
Phase 5 (Zaros): all-style enrage; no specific prayer works — damage race

enrage_phase.changes: player_damage_multiplier x1.25 (P14 asymmetric — reward for reaching phase 5); boss_damage_multiplier x2.0

bosses.counterplay: P11 strategic plurality — 3-style prayer-switching loadout OR single-style tank-through-smoke speedrun; both viable. Flag P17 concern: gated behind 5-phase clear in quest chain — now addressed via practice-mode instance in phase-3 training room.

bosses.name: Vardorvis
bosses.mechanic_summary: Rotating axe arena boss; 4 giant axes orbit the room in 2 directions. Player stands on designated 'safe path' tiles. Heal-on-stand healing pools spawn on incorrect tile choices (P05 compounding mistake).
attack_rotation: Tick 1: melee cleave (max 35 if in melee)
Tick 3: axe-rotation tick (orbit advances one tile)
Tick 6: heal-pool spawn (random tile; Vardorvis heals +10 HP if player stands on it for 2 ticks)
Tick 9: root attack (tethers player for 2 ticks; axes still move)

enrage_phase.changes: axe-rotation every 2 ticks instead of 3; heal-pool spawns accelerate

uniques.note: reagent: + rune axe = Executioner's Axe (slayer-niche vs undead + shade)

bosses.counterplay: stab weakness; axe-tile tracking is the puzzle; root+heal-pool timing is the compounding-mistake test (P05).

bosses.name: Sol Heredit
bosses.mechanic_summary: 3-style champion with grapple and shield-bash specials. Prayer must match weapon style he's currently using. Grapple pulls player into melee range at random tick. Shield-bash stuns player 1 tick.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: melee strike (sword-form, max 34)
Tick 4: ranged spear-throw (bow-form, max 32)
Tick 7: magic bolt (staff-form, max 36)
Tick 10: grapple (pull 5 tiles toward boss)
Tick 12: shield-bash (stun, break combo)

enrage_phase.changes: style rotation every 2 ticks instead of 3; adds feint — fake weapon-change, attack arrives as previous style

bosses.counterplay: P11 plurality — multi-style prayer-switch OR damage-race with dizana's quiver power-creep; grapple-counter = anti-grapple charms from Heartlands shop.

bosses.name: Pharaoh Lich (Boss)
bosses.mechanic_summary: Boneyard capstone. Summons a clerical staff of reanimated mummy-wardens who issue 'decrees' — each decree is a constraint the player must obey for 10 ticks, or take heavy damage. E.g., 'Decree: the Pharaoh demands silence' — casting spells incurs damage; 'Decree: the Pharaoh demands stillness' — moving deals 10 damage per step.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: staff blast (max 22, magic)
Tick 4: decree announcement (random from 4 constraints, active for 10 ticks)
Tick 6: bone-pile eruption (8 bone-swarm spawns, each does 3 damage on pickup)

enrage_phase.changes: two decrees active simultaneously; bone-piles explode on kill instead of harmless

uniques.note: ignores 20% magic defense on mummy-tag targets

bosses.counterplay: stab weakness; decree-reading is the core skill (P01 plurality — accept decree and take damage, or adapt loadout); bone-pile management is a mini-logistics puzzle.

bosses.name: The Forgotten-Name
bosses.mechanic_summary: Inkweald endgame boss. Unique mechanic: the boss's NAME cannot be spoken aloud. The in-game boss-timer and damage-log display '————' in place of the name. Combat itself uses attack-style swapping and reality-fold attacks that phase the player in/out of the dream plane.
attack_rotation: Tick 1: reality-fold (phase player out of dream plane — deals damage only inside dream; tick 2 phase them back)
Tick 4: forget-strike (max 25, cannot be prayed against without knowing the name)
Tick 7: name-inversion (player's equipped weapon display blanks for 5 ticks)
Tick 10: dream-wall (wall of unnamed memory sweeps across arena, impassable)

enrage_phase.changes: reality-fold every 2 ticks; name-inversion permanent until kill (weapon stats still apply, just the display is blank)

uniques.note: UNNAMEABLE item — the only item whose name cannot be spoken in-game. Confers prayer-pool bonus unique to this one item. Pillar 4 exemplar.

bosses.counterplay: ranged weakness; phase-timing (enter dream during fold-phase, burst DPS, retreat); the 'unknowable' mechanic is dialog-telegraphed via Inkweald NPC Daranda who describes the fight without naming.

P03_blitz_phase: all bosses — all have enrage phases defined
P14_asymmetric_escalation: nex_wilds_gwd (x1.25 player / x2.0 boss at phase 5)
